title: Home guide: where does ice melt fastest?
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: States of matter (Marvellous Medicine and How Far Can Sound Travel?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 10 (Home practical guide and safety card: ice melting test (portal worksheet; never touch radiators))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out how temperature affects how fast ice melts.
equipment: A kitchen thermometer if you have one
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put one ice cube on each saucer.
Put one in the fridge, one on a table and one in a warm (not hot) place.
Record which melts first and what you see each time.
